description: The bidder reports a network address of the VM; sent as the payload of a market.event.

kind.description: What address is. Absent, it reads as iroh when tag is absent and https when tag is present. iroh: address is the VM's iroh ticket. https: tag names the tunnel and address is its https URL. webrtc: tag names the tunnel and address is the guest agent's DTLS certificate fingerprint ("sha-256 AB:CD:..."), which the requester checks against the a=fingerprint of the guest's answer.

address.description: The VM's address for kind: the iroh ticket (iroh), the URL of the tagged tunnel (https), or the guest agent's DTLS certificate fingerprint "sha-256 AB:CD:..." (webrtc).

tag.description: Names one of the VM's tunnels (spec.tunnels of the contract); absent, address is the VM's iroh ticket.
